bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (screenshot markup editor), springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (canvas app), springboard/sdk/src/print.rs and springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (no markup API)
summary: PaperKit is an app-facing markup framework: view controllers, a vector-style markup data model with shapes, text, images, links and a loupe, and a feature set. BifrOSt has freehand drawing only (pen, marker, pencil, eraser, colours, undo) in the shell's screenshot editor and in the Freeform app, both flattened to PNG; neither exposes an SDK markup API, and no shape, text, image, link, loupe or editable data model exists.

features.note: Shell-only editor for screenshot captures. Apps get no view controller or SDK type for it.

features.note: Canvas size follows the window or capture. No resize policy for markup content.

gaps: No app-facing SDK markup API: no view controller, no markup data model, no shared type. Apps cannot embed a markup canvas.
No vector elements: shapes, text boxes, images, links and loupes are all missing; every mark is a raster stamp.
No editable, reloadable markup document; the shell and Freeform save a flattened PNG and discard the strokes.
No redo, no stroke selection or editing, no stylus pressure or tilt.
No feature set or rendering options exposed to apps.
